# coolify_environments (Data Source)

Lists the environments of a project.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "coolify_environments" "prod_project" {
  project_uuid = coolify_project.example.uuid
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_uuid` (String) UUID of the project to inspect.

### Read-Only

- `environments` (Attributes List) Environments of the project. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--environments))

<a id="nestedatt--environments"></a>
### Nested Schema for `environments`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Description.
- `name` (String) Name.
- `uuid` (String) UUID.
